title: A Psychological Character Study
grammar: Integrating valency pairs, reflexive suffixes, and psychological idioms
goal: I can synthesize valency alternations, -kodik/-ódik verbs, and reflexive pronouns in a psychological character study
I can interpret dreams, unconscious motives, and emotional ambiguity in literary Hungarian
I can read and analyze an adapted excerpt from Milán Füst's A feleségem története
